text:
maya: Heads-up 1: final announce checklist for Thu launch. Need: changelog link, docs preview with examples, precise canary windows, and HubSpot routing tag by EOD. Embargo 09:30 UTC. Can eng confirm rollout plan and thresholds? @jun
jun: Got it. Drafting canary now. Proposed ramp: 3% x 15m -> 10% x 30m -> 40% x 30m -> 100% if healthy. Abort conditions: 5xx > 0.8% OR p95 latency > 350ms. Will post the full plan in 30m.
elena: Docs PR open: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/128. Includes quickstart, embeddings example, and a short migration note. Need the final model name and changelog blurb to update the snippet.
maya: We'll wire the preview into the blog draft. Marketing will need the changelog commit hash to cite in the announcement and link the release notes.
jun: Changelog draft here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/def456. Human blurb: "Improve batching and add adaptive prefix cache for lower tail latency on long contexts." Feedback welcome.
tom: For inbound: use hubspot tag `launch_apr` (no spaces). Routing: tag -> marketing/sdr queue; if usage>100 reqs/day -> sales/tier1 via webhook. I'll paste rule IDs after this thread.
maya: Social cadence: T+0 blog, T+10 social, T+60 tweet thread + webinar CTA. Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-scale. Can we put the webinar reg link in the blog CTA?
elena: Yes, added CTA placeholder. Also added a short `curl` quickstart and JS snippet. Will change the model param once jun confirms `model: rwd-serve-v2`.
jun: Confirm `rwd-serve-v2`. Also: APAC will be staged — start regionally after full rollout to avoid cold-starts.
maya: Good call. Ops: we need the canary start time for calendar invites and the embargo slack reminder.
deploy-bot: [deploy-schedule] canary requested by jun for 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z
jun: Scheduling 09:00 UTC. I'll run the 15m dry-run at 08:30 UTC for teams to sanity-check dashboard and webinar flow. Checklist I'll bring: canary traffic, error rates, latency histograms, top-10 errors, and rollback command.
maya: 08:30 dry-run noted. Elena, can you rehearse the quickstart demo at that time?
elena: Yep, I'll demo the docs snippet and live example.
tom: Confirming HubSpot flow. Also set alerting on our side: mute social-triggered spikes, but auto-escalate if 500s persist > 5m.
maya: One more ask: marketing needs a short quote from eng for the blog (1-2 sentences) about why this rollout matters. Jun?
jun: "This rollout reduces tail latency for long-context workloads by leveraging adaptive prefix caching and smarter batching, making production inference both cheaper and more predictable." Use as-is.
maya: Perfect. I'll finalize blog and schedule T-30m embargo ping in #marketing. :rocket:
